prompts.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: production animation sprite sheet, transparent RGBA, for the existing DSH whale-girl desktop pet. Output a square 1024 x 1024 transparent sheet with EXACTLY four columns and four rows of equal 256 x 256 cells, in chronological row-major order. One complete full-body character in every cell. Keep her exact navy/blue long hair with cyan ends, whale fins and tail, white frilled maid headband, navy maid dress, white apron with whale emblem, gold trim, blue shoes, face, proportions and clean detailed anime chibi style. Do not redesign or beautify the face. Each character is the SAME SIZE and at the SAME foot baseline and horizontal center in its cell. Head-to-foot height about 224 pixels; foot baseline y=242 inside every cell, body center x=128. Never crop head, feet, hair or tail; leave transparent margins between cells. Motion: frame 1 neutral front-facing arms near body; frames 2-5 smoothly lift her right hand (viewer left); frames 6-11 softly wave side-to-side with small shoulder/hair/tail follow-through; frames 12-16 lower the hand smoothly back toward frame 1. Feet remain planted, torso doesn't wander sideways. Include intermediate arm and finger positions, slight gentle breathing; each pose changes only a small amount. No run, no jumping, no large squashing. NO panel borders, NO grid lines, NO labels, NO text, NO numerals, NO shadows beneath the feet, NO background colors or checkerboard. True alpha transparency. Keep all sixteen cells precisely aligned for automatic frame extraction.
